why: Figures go in pairs: D is B turned upside down (rotated 180 degrees). In the same way C must be A rotated 180 degrees: circles stay top-left and bottom-right, the straight arrow moves to the top-right pointing down-left, and the curved arrow moves to the bottom-left pointing right. That is option 5. Option 3 looks close but its straight arrow points up-right, the wrong way.
trick: If the 1st and 3rd figures look alike, test a half turn (180 degrees) between them, as between the 2nd and 4th.
